audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].side read 'Skill' against content win[5]='Zed', and phases[6].side read 'Skill' against content win[6]='Aurora'. The packet agrees with the content layer on both.
audit.why: First-item lethality kills her out of Death Mark while Across the Veil is spent; two items in, the leap plus the Between Worlds slow field outlast a 3s mark.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side=Zed, phases[6].side=Aurora with phases[6].why rewritten to match. Rows 0-4 already agreed and were left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose gave no cooldown for the ability the whole matchup is keyed to.
audit.why: Across the Veil is 22s at rank 1 down to 18s at rank 5 — that is the kill window, and The Weirding at 15s is the poke beat.
audit.corrected: Real numbers in breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid and dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: A fabricated ability name, 'Across the Sand', shipped in six content fields for what is really Across the Veil (W). spikes[3].text also called The Weirding her R — The Weirding is E and her R is Between Worlds. The page further described W as a 'cleanse-dash'; Riot's text says only that she leaps, enters the spirit realm invisible, and gains Move Speed.
audit.why: enemyKit slots: P Spirit Abjuration, Q Twofold Hex, W Across the Veil, E The Weirding, R Between Worlds. Riot W text: 'Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible, and gaining Move Speed'.
audit.corrected: All six 'Across the Sand' occurrences replaced with Across the Veil, The Weirding relabelled to Between Worlds in spikes[3].text, and the unsupported cleanse claim replaced with the leap/invisibility Riot actually describes.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.
audit.corrected: Across the Veil 22s to 18s, The Weirding 15s at rank 1, Between Worlds 140s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentioned anti-heal, though Spirit Abjuration heals her off every spell and attack she lands.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal; Riot's passive text: 'Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her.'
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds timing stated in breakdown.early, breakdown.mid and tradeGood.

notes: 'Across the Sand' was a fabricated name in six content fields; the real ability is Across the Veil (W). spikes[3].text also mislabelled The Weirding as her R when it is E and her R is Between Worlds. The page repeatedly called W a 'cleanse-dash' — Riot's text describes a leap into the spirit realm with invisibility and Move Speed and says nothing about cleansing, so the claim was removed rather than restated; whether it actually cleanses is listed as unverified. Chart: only rows 5 and 6 disagreed across layers; content win[N] already matched the packet, so sides moved alone and phases[6].why was rewritten to describe Aurora winning.
